shell_rule: X < p*q <= floor(X*(denominator+numerator)/denominator), p<=q, p and q exact primes
exact_integer_reference: deterministic sieve-generated prime table; shell bounds use integer division only
independent_spotcheck: deterministic 64-bit Miller-Rabin primality plus direct product-bound verification on a fixed hash-selected sample

views.raw: factor pair (p,q), plus derived S3 orbit for visualization only
views.scale_trim: p^4 > X (exact integer equivalent of p > X^(1/4))
views.prime_rank: normalized pi(p) rank among scale-trim eligible p values

density_flat_rationale: first-order semiprime shell intensity in u is proportional to 1/(u*(1-u)); the stated logit transform is its normalized CDF on [1/4,1/2]
primary_profile: 24-bin density-flat z occupancy on the exact scale-trim set

null_A.name: band_residue_local_density_permutation
null_A.procedure: for each scale/width, decompose each eligible p's exact q-interval count by q mod 30; within each (coarse u-band, p mod 30, q mod 30) stratum, independently permute those channel counts across eligible p positions; then recombine into the 24-bin z profile
preserves: exact shell margins through observed interval counts

null_B.name: cross_scale_cyclic_phase_surrogate
null_B.procedure: after Null-A standardization, independently apply a uniformly random nonzero cyclic shift to each scale-width residual profile before cross-scale aggregation

discovery_statistic: A_b = arithmetic mean of Z over all 5 discovery scales and all 3 widths; T=max_b abs(A_b)
familywise_threshold: 99th empirical percentile of the same max statistic under each null family
feature_selection_rule: b_star=argmax_b abs(A_b), ties to smallest b; sign=sign(A_b_star)

discovery_consistency_gate.scale_sign: at least 4 of 5 scale composites (mean over widths at b_star) share the selected sign
discovery_consistency_gate.width_sign: at least 2 of 3 width composites (mean over scales at b_star) share the selected sign
discovery_consistency_gate.nulls: T exceeds the 99th empirical familywise threshold under both Null A and Null B

holdout_rule: freeze b_star and sign after discovery; for each holdout scale compute H=mean over 3 widths of the Null-A-standardized Z at b_star using that holdout's own preregistered Null-A ensemble; both holdout H values must have the frozen sign and abs(H)>=1.645
